scripts.deploy: node sync-tina-media.js && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.clean: rm -rf .next node_modules package-lock.json out && npm install

// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.predev: Automatically kills port 9000 to prevent TinaCMS port conflicts
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.dev: MAIN DEVELOPMENT COMMAND - Starts Next.js, TinaCMS, and Media Proxy for local editing
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.build: Builds a static version of the site using Next.js static export
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.deploy: MAIN DEPLOYMENT COMMAND - Verifies media, builds static site, and deploys to Firebase hosting
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.sync-media: Verifies media files are available for deployment
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.proxy: Runs only the media proxy server (for debugging)
// SCRIPTS EXPLAINED.clean: Cleans all build artifacts and reinstalls dependencies (troubleshooting)
